dedupe_keys.name: ecopia ai vector maps 3d land cover advanced transportation features and global feature extraction

description: Ecopia AI converts high-resolution aerial and satellite imagery into vector maps with machine learning, and sells the results as off-the-shelf and custom datasets. Coverage: 3D Land Cover gives planimetric vector layers for natural and impervious surfaces, including buildings with height attribution, roads, driveways, sidewalks, water bodies, sports fields and overlapping tree canopy, with features attributed by width and material and stated geometric accuracy above 95 percent, available for instant access across 400 US cities; Advanced Transportation Features gives sidewalks, crosswalks, medians, bike lanes, turning lanes, paint striping and intersections, launched off the shelf across North America with Nearmap; Global Feature Extraction produces custom vector maps of any feature visible in imagery anywhere in the world; a building-based geocoding product adds flood zone and change detection attributes. Format and access: vector data delivered through a self-serve data portal and custom orders; annual updates follow new imagery from partner providers. Licence: commercial; the terms of use page was not read. Caveats: prices and exact file formats are not given on the pages read; accuracy figures are the vendor's own. Simulation uses: building footprints and heights, impervious surfaces and street assets for hazard exposure, stormwater and active mobility network models, and digital twins of cities. Related records: Nearmap aerial imagery and AI layers (data-nearmap-aerial-imagery-and-ai-layers) and the NYC 3-D building model (data-nyc-3d-building-massing-model-oti).
